sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Endings system in Escape from Tarkov represents the final progression stage within the game's storyline, allowing players to reach one of four endings based on their decisions throughout the story chapters. The endings reflect different allegiances, moral choices and outcomes for the player's PMC, marking the conclusion of their journey in Tarkov. Each ending comes with a special dogtag, armband, achievement, hideout customization, main menu background and an icon shown in the player profile.

If you plan to pursue a specific ending, take time to study each route carefully and review all related information before committing to your decisions. Once completed, there is no rewind button, all choices are final. It is possible to experience all four endings by resetting your game profile or through the Prestige system.

sections.heading: Savior
sections.text: "Escaped from Tarkov for humanity: You placed your trust in Kerman - a step far beyond the mere instinct to survive. The strike against TerraGroup tore apart their mask: secrets were laid bare, corrupt politicians lost their power, and humanity cast off its chains and breathed free. People realized they could live differently, without descending into ruin. You escaped from Tarkov, but with you, the truth broke free as well. You did it for the sake of all of us."

sections.heading: Debtor
sections.text: "Escaped from Tarkov but didn't escape from yourself: You nearly touched the truth, but you froze halfway, calling your fear caution. Kerman remembered you as unreliable. Everything you had uncovered dissolved into the swelling chaos. TerraGroup survived and grew stronger. Now you remain nothing more than a mercenary without honor, bound by a debt that weighs upon your heart. You broke out, but couldn't escape. You will never escape from yourself."

sections.heading: Survivor
sections.text: "Escaped from Tarkov and survived: You ran, hoping to escape. It seemed like it would all end outside Tarkov—but hell erupted behind you. You didn't know you were part of the chain that destroyed the city. While the ashes were still warm, TerraGroup was reborn—and the world fell at its feet. You survived. But at what cost."

sections.heading: Fallen
sections.text: "Escaped from Tarkov to fall in the darkness: You did not believe him — you hid behind fear and called it caution. Tarkov had fallen, and with it came madness; people lost their minds, the world began to crack apart. TerraGroup returned as a savior — but it was them who brought the ruin. You wanted to survive, but you fell. Into the Darkness, with no way back."
